LESSON: WRITING 5.4.1 CREATIVE WRITING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.4: Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do you enjoy listening to stories? 2. Why is it important to plan our composition?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the parts of a narrative composition in preparation for writing,
2. organise thoughts fluently, clearly and precisely in a coherent paragraph for self- expression,
3. create a narrative composition of about 60-80 words for self-expression,
4. realise the role of creativity in writing for different purposes. The learner is guided to: write a draft and present it to the whole class, compositions interesting, them in their composition, about 60-80 words and incorporate similes, an oral narrative into coherent paragraphs, television and rewrite it in their own words, to the theme (could be from a digital device), enjoy listening to stories? important to plan our composition? write an interesting composition? 40 grocery store in the school neighbourhood and write a narrative composition based on that experience.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing.
2. Explain Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing.
4. Show that you can: describe the parts of a narrative composition in preparation for writing,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why do you enjoy listening to stories? 2. Why is it important to plan our composition?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
